title: Linux/Wine workaround?
summary: Hi, I came over from Reddit. I thought it would be easier to create an issue here for Linux compatibility. My original message was: "not working on my end (Arch Linux - CachyOS) despite trying with Wine and installing the Edge WebView2 library. `Unhandled exception: unimplemented function ntdll.dll.NtCreateWaitCompletionPacket called in 64-bit code` This syscall isn't implemented in Wine from what I've seen, and it's required by the Windows App SDK runtime the launcher depends on." I suggested creating a release with just the basic mod and the .ini file, because I understand that this app was built for Windows first. I'm quite new to Linux, so I might not know everything yet, but from what I've tried so far, this is the first issue I haven't been able to find a workaround for. Thanks in advance!
